posts.title: Pi, more than a coding harness
posts.description: Pi, more than a coding harness I’m a big fan of the Pi coding harness . Pi is a coding tool like Claude Code, but minimalist and open, so can be completely customized to your liking. I primarily use gpt-5.6 through an OpenAI subscription with Pi, thank you OpenAI for being open to other tools. You can also connect directly to APIs. posts.title: Ask LLMs to Teach You, Not Tell You
posts.description: Ask LLMs to Teach You, Not Tell You A large language model can help you understand a subject, but usually people just use it to get an answer. This won’t help you. It matters who is doing the work and thinking. You should try to use assistants to provide hints, encourage effort, and give you feedback and not just a quick answer. That is if you want to learn.
